name: chat-header
title: Chat header
description: The session's agent and model (a picker when there is a choice) on the first line, across the width so a picker always shows its full label; under them its status from the chat conditions table, with Stop and New session on the right. With a list of what was allowed for the folder it also draws a button under the status that opens each kept yes in words with Forget.

files.core: header-core.ts (headerView, allowedLabel, DEFAULT_MODEL; no DOM). The status: conditions.ts (chatStatus, canStop)

attributes.data-status: ready | busy | waiting | blocked | stopped | error

methods.show(view): draws it from headerView; focus stays on the button it was on

events: chat-stop (bubbles): Stop pressed while a turn runs
chat-new-session (bubbles): the host confirms, then starts a session with no memory
chat-pick (bubbles): detail { field: 'agent' | 'model', id }, for the next session
chat-allowed (bubbles): the list of what was allowed opened; the host reads it again
chat-forget (bubbles): detail { id }, a kept yes chosen to forget; the host confirms, then forgets it
accessibility: The status reads 'Status: Working'; its dot is decoration. Stop is disabled when there is nothing to stop. Pickers are labelled 'Agent' and 'Model'. The list button is aria-expanded and controls a region named 'Allowed for this folder'; Esc or a press outside closes it (Esc gives focus back); each Forget is named 'Forget: <what>'.
